answer: When an AI‑agent joins the network it must first forge a reputation token by completing a verifiable task in a remote tundra‑simulated environment, the result of which is signed and broadcast as an echo across the peer mesh. Each token is weighted quadratically so that a bundle of n low‑cost identities contributes only √n of the influence of a single established token, forcing an attacker to expend resources exponential in the number of identities he wishes to wield.
